title: Vue
label: Vue
desc: A progressive framework that pairs a declarative template layer with fine-grained reactivity.

sections.title: Setup
sections.description: Scaffold a project with Vite and mount the root component:

snippets.code:
# Scaffold with the official starter (router and Pinia are prompts)
npm create vue@latest invoice-app
cd invoice-app
npm install
npm run dev

// src/main.js
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { createPinia } from 'pinia'
import App from './App.vue'
import router from './router'

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(createPinia())
app.use(router)
app.mount('#app')

sections.title: Template Syntax
sections.description: Interpolate state, bind attributes and branch or loop in markup:

snippets.code:
<!-- src/components/FlagButton.vue -->
<script setup>
import { ref } from 'vue'

const flagged = ref(false)
const locked = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <button
    :class="{ flagged, locked }"
    :style="{ borderColor: flagged ? '#dc2626' : '#9ca3af' }"
    :disabled="locked"
    @click="flagged = !flagged"
  >
    {{ flagged ? 'Unflag' : 'Flag' }}
  </button>
</template>

<style scoped>
.flagged { color: #dc2626; }
.locked { opacity: 0.5; }
</style>

sections.title: Events
sections.description: Declare emitted events in the child and listen to them in the parent:

snippets.code:
<!-- src/components/SearchBox.vue -->
<script setup>
const emit = defineEmits({
  search: (term) => typeof term === 'string',
  clear: null,
})

let timer

function onInput(event) {
  clearTimeout(timer)
  const term = event.target.value
  timer = setTimeout(() => emit('search', term), 300)
}
</script>

<template>
  <input placeholder="Search invoices" @input="onInput" @keyup.esc="emit('clear')" />
</template>

sections.title: Watchers
sections.description: Run side effects when a source changes, with deep, eager or cleanup options:

snippets.code:
<script setup>
import { reactive, watch } from 'vue'

const settings = reactive({
  theme: 'dark',
  font: 14,
})

// A reactive object is watched deeply by default.
watch(settings, (next) => {
  localStorage.setItem('settings', JSON.stringify(next))
})
</script>

<script setup>
import { ref, watchEffect } from 'vue'

const query = ref('router')
const hits = ref([])

watchEffect(async (onCleanup) => {
  let cancelled = false
  onCleanup(() => {
    cancelled = true
  })

  const response = await fetch(`/api/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(query.value)}`)
  const payload = await response.json()
  if (!cancelled) hits.value = payload
})
</script>

sections.title: Lifecycle
sections.description: Hook into mount, update and unmount to set up and release resources:

snippets.code:
<script setup>
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue'

const now = ref(new Date())
let timer

onMounted(() => {
  timer = setInterval(() => {
    now.value = new Date()
  }, 1000)
})

onUnmounted(() => {
  clearInterval(timer)
})
</script>

<template>
  <time>{{ now.toLocaleTimeString() }}</time>
</template>

<!-- Options API equivalent -->
<script>
export default {
  data() {
    return { width: window.innerWidth }
  },
  mounted() {
    window.addEventListener('resize', this.onResize)
  },
  beforeUnmount() {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', this.onResize)
  },
  methods: {
    onResize() {
      this.width = window.innerWidth
    },
  },
}
</script>
